en.headline: Hong Kong Sixes reaches finals day with Cup final set for afternoon
en.dek: Afghanistan and Australia meet in the Cup final at Mission Road Ground, while classification matches continue through the morning.
body: The 22nd Hong Kong Sixes entered its final day on Sunday at Mission Road Ground in Mong Kok, with classification matches and the three finals scheduled.

Afghanistan and Australia advanced to the Cup final after winning their semi-finals on Saturday. The Cup final was set for 12:40pm, with the Plate final between Oman and Pakistan at 11:45am and the Bowl final between England and South Africa at 10:50am.
Hong Kong, China faced Sri Lanka in the 7th-place play-off earlier in the morning. The short-format tournament, organised by Cricket Hong Kong, China, featured 12 teams over three days.

zh.headline: 香港六人板球賽決賽日 阿富汗對澳洲爭冠
zh.dek: 阿富汗與澳洲將在旺角美善道運動場進行盃賽決賽，分類賽繼續在上午舉行。
body: 第22屆香港六人板球賽周日進入最後一天，在旺角美善道運動場進行分類賽及三場決賽。
阿富汗與澳洲在周六準決賽勝出後晉級盃賽決賽。盃賽決賽定於下午12時40分舉行，而銀牌決賽由阿曼對巴基斯坦於上午11時45分進行，銅牌決賽則由英格蘭對南非於上午10時50分進行。
香港隊今早與斯里蘭卡進行第7名爭奪戰。這項由香港板球總會主辦的短版賽事，有12支隊伍參賽，為期三日。
